description: Create a public Casatoo URL for an exact location_id returned by casatoo_search_locations. This is a strict two-step flow: never pass place text or invent an ID. Include only filters the user provided; do not guess missing criteria.

gross_area_max.description: Maximum gross floor area in square metres, inclusive; e.g. 150. Omit for no maximum.

gross_area_min.description: Minimum gross floor area in square metres, inclusive; e.g. 80. Omit for no minimum.

location_id.description: Exact Casatoo location ID returned by casatoo_search_locations. Free-text locations are not accepted.

price_max.description: Maximum asking price in EUR, inclusive; e.g. 500000. Omit for no maximum.

price_min.description: Minimum asking price in EUR, inclusive; e.g. 200000. Omit for no minimum.

property_category.description: Optional property category, e.g. apartment or house; omit for any category.

rooms.description: Portuguese bedroom typologies. T2 means two bedrooms and T5+ matches Casatoo listings with five or more bedrooms. An empty list means any room count.

sort_by.description: Search-link ordering; defaults explicitly to newest.

name: casatoo_build_search_link

id.description: Exact location ID to pass unchanged to listing search and search-link tools.

location_type.description: Administrative level: DISTRICT, MUNICIPALITY, PARISH, or NEIGHBORHOOD.

title: Build a public Casatoo search link
